node.statement: Sum the identities of node 1.2.1 over i,j. Finite bilinearity of dot and linearity of the inner product in its second variable identify the left side with 2*<Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X>*u_Q. Matrix row-column multiplication identifies the two right-side sums respectively as (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X and Y^dagger dot (Z dot X). This proves node 1.2 without reassociating any triple product.
